name: util-executor-cwm-sol
description: Evalaute the expressions of a single device command. The command has its own expression to be evaluated. Failure: 1) If the command is not executed in NSO. 2) If there is an error in parsing the command output returned from NSO using the template. 3) If the conditions provided in the expression evaluate to false.
